_doc: What we know about the embroidery factory. Builders read frames/needles/spm from here (never hard-code 360). Update when the factory answers the F1 page.
name: Mandy's factory (Mandy Luo)
thread_brands: factory's thread supplier colour book (brand to confirm)
price_basis: unknown — ask: per 1,000 stitches, per trim, per hooping, or per piece
needles_note: Manufacturer, 2026-10-16: max 12 distinct colours per stitch file (incl. basting / registration — sew those in a colour already in the file). Colour changes / repeated stops are fine.
embroiders: cut pieces (before the garment is sewn)
factory_answers_2026_10_19: Brother machines, biggest 750 mm; frames 300x300 and 400x450; embroider cut pieces; front 340x505 single hooping OK; back 690x575 = two hoopings combined; chenille yes; 3D puff yes; jacquard sherpa normally no problem; embroidery on sherpa yes; thread colour book from their supplier. Open: which frame holds the 340x505 front (505 > 450); sleeve 500x510 in one hooping?; thread brand name; send the colour book; sherpa design for review.
open_questions: chenille: which machine (Tajima TMCE / Barudan BEMR / other), which file format, loop (moss) / chain mode and needle (loop) height set in the file or at the machine, which chenille yarns + colours (engine M6: chenille + true chain are planned, the machine file raises FactoryFormatNeeded until chenille_format is set)

3D puff: do your Brother heads sew satin stitches longer than 7.5 mm over foam (published practice: 10-12 mm columns)? Until confirmed, puff columns are capped at 7 mm. Also confirm foam (3 mm), needle and speed at the strike-off.

suppliers._doc: Every supplier other than the top-level embroidery factory (key 'mandy'). max_colours per method; a method missing here is NOT RECORDED (engine/supplier_gate.py never passes it). Record a limit only with its source.

embroidery.source: Emmie, WhatsApp 2026-03-15: 'embroidery color cannot exceed 9 colors' (the Rainbow hat design had 10; quoted in missions/sampling-strategist/evidence-sample-history.md)
